requirement: Register, edit, disable and remove multiple independent Supabase Cloud and self-hosted projects.
acceptance_criterion: Five projects can be configured and operated independently without cross-project data leakage.

requirement: Support guided connection using Supabase connection string/project reference and advanced PostgreSQL TLS connection details.
acceptance_criterion: Wizard verifies DNS, TLS hostname, credentials, server version and required permissions.

requirement: Discover supported backup/restore capabilities for database, Storage, Auth, Edge Functions, settings and secrets.
acceptance_criterion: Per-component capability matrix records supported, manual, unsupported and unknown with evidence and timestamp.

requirement: Support direct PostgreSQL connections and supported session-pooler fallback without assuming transaction pooling is suitable for dumps.
acceptance_criterion: Connection diagnostics distinguish modes and validate actual dump operation.

requirement: Protect connection secrets in Keychain/vault and redact logs.
acceptance_criterion: No secret value appears in SQLite, diagnostic bundles or client responses.

requirement: Discover schema/table inventory, project version, extensions, storage buckets, functions and exportable settings.
acceptance_criterion: Inventory refresh detects changes and marks incomplete discovery.

requirement: Tag projects by environment, owner, criticality and dependent applications.
acceptance_criterion: Reports and schedules filter by tags; dependencies appear in recovery plans.

requirement: Isolate tenants/projects in API, catalogue and archive paths.
acceptance_criterion: Authorisation tests prevent project A users accessing project B data.

requirement: Create coordinated recovery sets with independently versioned component archives and capture timestamps.
acceptance_criterion: Manifest lists all selected components, completeness and capture consistency window.

requirement: Support PostgreSQL full logical, schema-only, data-only, selected-schema and selected-table exports.
acceptance_criterion: Test restores reproduce expected objects, rows and constraints.

requirement: Capture recoverable database roles/grants, extensions, triggers, functions, views, sequences and RLS definitions.
acceptance_criterion: Manifest identifies every included/excluded object and privileged-operation limitation.

requirement: Capture Storage bucket definitions, policies, metadata and actual object bytes; do not confuse metadata with files.
acceptance_criterion: Object counts, bytes and checksums reconcile with enumerated source at capture boundary.

requirement: Capture permitted Auth users, identities and related records plus exportable Auth configuration without leaking credential material.
acceptance_criterion: Restore drill verifies sign-in scenarios; missing signing/OAuth/SMTP secrets are disclosed.

requirement: Archive Edge Function source from linked Git/source bundle, deployment manifests and runtime settings where accessible.
acceptance_criterion: Every deployed function maps to a recoverable source revision or is flagged as a blocking gap.

requirement: Capture available project settings, database/webhook/cron/realtime configuration and external integration inventory.
acceptance_criterion: Recovery report separates automatically restorable settings from manual steps.

requirement: Capture secret names and references; escrow values only via supported authorised source and separate encryption policy.
acceptance_criterion: No unsupported claim of exporting unreadable secrets; restoration plan identifies regeneration/rotation.

requirement: Support per-project hourly/daily/weekly/monthly and custom schedules, timezone and DST handling.
acceptance_criterion: Scheduler runs intended local wall-clock policy and documents DST handling.

requirement: Persist job state, retries, backoff, cancellation and restart reconciliation.
acceptance_criterion: Crash during dump/upload cannot produce completed status; safe retry resumes or restarts.

requirement: Allow manual on-demand backup and pre-deployment API/CLI trigger.
acceptance_criterion: Authorised trigger creates traceable job with idempotency key.

requirement: Support backup verification by checksums, signed manifests, archive inspection and periodic actual restore tests.
acceptance_criterion: Corrupt archive is rejected; successful checksum alone is not labelled restore-tested.

requirement: Capture source versions, client tool versions, permissions, exclusions, warnings, duration and size.
acceptance_criterion: Backup detail report displays provenance and compatibility.

requirement: Support differential or incremental strategies only where a validated provider-specific mechanism exists.
acceptance_criterion: Unsupported modes are disabled and clearly explained, not simulated with unqualified full dumps.

requirement: Do not label independent component captures as a single atomic point-in-time snapshot.
acceptance_criterion: Manifest exposes start/end timestamps and cross-component consistency limitations.

requirement: Store encrypted backups on local volumes and AWS S3, Azure Blob, Google Drive and OneDrive.
acceptance_criterion: Integration tests upload, list, download, decrypt and verify from each provider.

requirement: Support multiple simultaneous destinations and per-replica status.
acceptance_criterion: Partial upload failure does not mark all replicas successful.

requirement: Encrypt archives client-side using authenticated encryption and unique data keys.
acceptance_criterion: Tampered ciphertext fails verification; no plaintext reaches cloud destination.

requirement: Support independently recoverable master-key escrow and documented key rotation.
acceptance_criterion: Fresh machine recovers an archive without original Mac or Keychain.

requirement: Support resumable/multipart transfers where provider permits and retry with backoff.
acceptance_criterion: Simulated interruption recovers without publishing a partial archive.

requirement: Apply configurable retention by project, policy, backup class and destination.
acceptance_criterion: Expiry dry-run and execution preserve pinned and minimum-good backups.

requirement: Support immutability/legal hold on capable providers, with clearly labelled limitations elsewhere.
acceptance_criterion: Deletion attempts fail during immutable retention; UI does not misrepresent Drive/OneDrive.

requirement: Forecast storage use and detect capacity/quota thresholds.
acceptance_criterion: Warnings fire before configured threshold; graphs reconcile with catalogue.

requirement: Use signed/versioned manifests and content hashes, with atomic publication after all mandatory checks.
acceptance_criterion: Unfinished set is not discoverable as complete.

requirement: Preserve enough catalogue metadata off-host for disaster recovery.
acceptance_criterion: Portable recovery CLI discovers remote archives after total host loss.

requirement: Provide guided restore for full supported database, schema, table, selected rows and Storage objects/buckets.
acceptance_criterion: Each mode passes isolated-target integration test.

requirement: Provide full-project recovery wizard covering database, Storage, Auth, functions, settings, secrets and dependencies.
acceptance_criterion: Drill rebuilds supported project in clean environment and lists manual actions.

requirement: Default to isolated target; production overwrite requires impact preview, fresh safety backup and explicit confirmation.
acceptance_criterion: Unsafe restore cannot proceed without required gates.

requirement: Stage row-level recovery, preview primary-key changes, foreign keys, triggers, sequences and conflicts.
acceptance_criterion: Preview lists inserts/updates/conflicts; no unrelated row changes.

requirement: Check version compatibility and required privileges before restore.
acceptance_criterion: Unsupported major-version/extension mismatch blocks or generates remediation plan.

requirement: Restore functions from verified source revision and reapply supported settings in dependency order.
acceptance_criterion: Function smoke tests pass; unexportable secret values require guided entry.

requirement: Validate Auth by test accounts/provider flows, not just record counts.
acceptance_criterion: Defined sign-in tests pass or recovery remains conditional.

requirement: Support portable CLI recovery from off-site archives on replacement macOS/Linux host.
acceptance_criterion: Fresh-machine drill succeeds without original service database.

requirement: Generate step-by-step cutover/rollback plan for application environment variables, URLs, DNS and external providers.
acceptance_criterion: Cutover is approval-gated and rollback steps are testable.

requirement: Record measured RPO/RTO, restore logs, verification evidence and unresolved gaps.
acceptance_criterion: Recovery report shows elapsed time, latest usable point and failed checks.

requirement: Support selective restore into new table/schema or controlled merge into existing target.
acceptance_criterion: Destination options are distinct and audited.

requirement: Expose managed PITR only if source provider and plan offer a supported integration.
acceptance_criterion: UI distinguishes managed PITR from logical backups and shows supported time range.

requirement: Provide signed native SwiftUI macOS application with dashboard, project setup, jobs, restores and settings.
acceptance_criterion: All essential workflows usable without Terminal.

requirement: Provide responsive secure web dashboard for desktop, tablet and phone.
acceptance_criterion: Core monitoring and authorised restore workflow pass viewport tests.

requirement: Display textual and graphical backup history, success/failure, durations, sizes and storage trends.
acceptance_criterion: Figures reconcile with underlying job records.

requirement: Show per-component recovery readiness: recoverable, manual steps, at risk or unknown.
acceptance_criterion: Status derives from evidence and does not rely on arbitrary percentages.

requirement: Provide searchable/filterable archive catalogue and table/object inventory.
acceptance_criterion: User can find backup by project, date, type and object.

requirement: Provide notifications for failure, overdue backup, low space, replication failure and failed restore drill.
acceptance_criterion: Test event generates notification with actionable context.

requirement: Support accessible controls, keyboard navigation, VoiceOver and WCAG 2.2 AA web target.
acceptance_criterion: Automated and manual accessibility review passes defined checklist.

requirement: Provide exportable audit, backup and recovery reports in CSV/JSON/PDF.
acceptance_criterion: Exports match filtered data and respect role permissions.

requirement: Support multi-user identity, MFA/passkeys or OIDC, secure sessions and account recovery.
acceptance_criterion: Unauthenticated and expired sessions are denied.

requirement: Enforce project-scoped RBAC for Viewer, Operator, Administrator and Recovery Approver.
acceptance_criterion: Permission matrix is enforced server-side for every endpoint.

requirement: Require step-up authentication and optional dual approval for destructive production restores and key changes.
acceptance_criterion: Requester cannot self-approve when dual control enabled.

requirement: Protect API using TLS, CSRF defences, rate limits, secure cookies and strict origin controls.
acceptance_criterion: Security tests show no bypass via browser or direct API.

requirement: Restrict remote access to private network by default; never expose database or admin service ports publicly by default.
acceptance_criterion: Network scan confirms only intended interfaces reachable.

requirement: Use least-privilege source/cloud credentials and separate backup-write from deletion privileges where supported.
acceptance_criterion: Credential audit confirms permissions are scoped.

requirement: Record tamper-evident audit events for sign-in, settings, backup, restore, deletion, export and key actions.
acceptance_criterion: Audit entries contain actor, project, time, action and result without secrets.

requirement: Support sensitive-data classification, configurable log redaction and no backup content in telemetry.
acceptance_criterion: Secret and personal-data leakage tests pass.

requirement: Support configurable data retention and deletion, privacy notices and access reporting.
acceptance_criterion: Retention and audit policies are independently configurable.

requirement: Pin dependencies, generate SBOM, scan releases, sign/notarise Mac builds and verify updates.
acceptance_criterion: Release pipeline blocks critical unresolved findings and unsigned binaries.

requirement: Run unattended as launchd-managed service independent of GUI login.
acceptance_criterion: Jobs execute with app closed and after supported reboot sequence.

requirement: Use crash-safe metadata transactions and reconcile in-progress jobs on restart.
acceptance_criterion: Fault-injection test leaves no falsely completed job.

requirement: Provide structured logs, metrics, health checks and diagnostic export.
acceptance_criterion: Operator can diagnose a failed backup without secrets.

requirement: Support at least 20 projects and configurable concurrency without overloading source databases.
acceptance_criterion: Load test meets policy deadlines for documented reference dataset.

requirement: Use bounded memory and disk working space; detect insufficient free space before dump.
acceptance_criterion: Low-space test fails safely and alerts.

requirement: Preserve archive readability across supported application upgrades.
acceptance_criterion: N-1 version archive restore succeeds after upgrade.

requirement: Provide signed installer, migration, rollback and update documentation.
acceptance_criterion: Upgrade and rollback rehearsals preserve catalogue and jobs.

requirement: Document and measure per-project RPO/RTO, default provisional targets 24h/8h.
acceptance_criterion: Drill records measured values and flags missed objectives.

requirement: Support UK English and timezone-aware scheduling, including DST.
acceptance_criterion: DST test cases pass without unintended duplicate destructive operations.

requirement: Support self-hosted deployments with explicit version/capability checks and documented supported topologies.
acceptance_criterion: Representative Docker/self-hosted deployment completes backup and recovery drill.
